lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce₂Zr₂ (reduced formula CeZr) crystallizes in the triclinic space group P1, with four atoms per unit cell distributed across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ce centers with 14 neighbors (8 Ce, 6 Zr) and Zr centers with 10 neighbors (4 Ce, 6 Zr), the latter described as a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all four sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Ce and Zr coordination polyhedra, with Ce–Zr polyhedra sharing corners and faces.
